fields.Name: Shipping
fields.Description: Delivery cost. Computed and allocated to lines, never entered as a catalog line — a line is user-editable, a charge is system-computed with an override trail.

fields.Name: Handling
fields.Description: Packing and handling, separate from carriage so the two can be reported and waived independently.

fields.Name: Sales Tax
fields.Description: A sales/use tax layer. Multi-layer tax is several charges of this type, one per jurisdiction, which is why tax needs no concept of its own.

fields.Name: VAT
fields.Description: Value-added tax layer, computed on the line net plus prior charges.

fields.Name: Surcharge
fields.Description: A generic surcharge. Seeded but deliberately NOT linked to a GL account by the integration fixture, so there is always a charge type available to prove that an unbookable charge REFUSES rather than being silently omitted from the entry.
